title: Power Display flyout does not scroll when multiple monitors are connected

judgment.rationale: The report clearly describes a six-display overflow, but it predates the pinned source, which now contains an explicit vertical ScrollViewer and adaptive window-height logic. Confirm whether the failure remains before proposing a competing scroll implementation.
evidence: The report says only five of six displays fit in the flyout on PowerToys 0.99.1.
The pinned source wraps monitor content in MainScrollViewer with VerticalScrollBarVisibility=Auto.
MainWindow.xaml.cs caps the viewer height to the available display area.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the reporter to retest the current release and distinguish missing scroll affordance from scroll input not moving the list.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current source already implements a scrollable, height-constrained monitor list. Until a current build demonstrates a remaining failure, no new code fix is grounded.

issue_context.summary: A six-monitor Power Display flyout showed only five monitors in a 0.99.1 report.
known_information: The report identifies six connected displays and says the last one is inaccessible.
The issue screenshot is attached to the original report.
The pinned source currently provides a vertical ScrollViewer and adaptive flyout height.
inferences: A code path may already have changed since the reported 0.99.1 build; this is not proof that the fix shipped.
If the issue persists, the remaining defect may be scroll interaction or flyout clipping rather than missing list scrolling.
issue_context.analysis: Do not claim the pinned implementation is shipped or resolved. Ask only whether the original overflow remains on a current release and how scrolling behaves.
initial_investigation: Read issue body and screenshot reference; no comments or linked fix are present.
Read src/modules/PowerDisplay/PowerDisplay/PowerDisplayXAML/MainWindow.xaml.cs: AdjustWindowSizeToContent limits the scroll viewer to available height.

information_gaps.information: Whether the six-monitor flyout still loses access to entries on the current PowerToys version; if it does, whether the scrollbar is absent or scrolling by wheel/keyboard also fails.
information_gaps.why_needed: The pinned current source wraps the flyout content in a vertical ScrollViewer and sizes it to the available display area; the issue was reported on 0.99.1, so a current failure would identify whether the problem remains in layout or input handling.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On the current installed release, open Power Display with the six monitors connected; report the exact version, the last visible monitor, and whether wheel, Page Down, or the scrollbar can reveal the remaining entries.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting the six-display limit and including a screenshot. The current source already has a height-limited, vertically scrollable monitor list, so this may have changed since 0.99.1. Could you retry the current release and tell us its exact version, which monitor is last visible, and whether the wheel, Page Down, or scrollbar can reveal the remaining display? This will distinguish a stale report from a remaining scrolling or clipping failure.
